scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: Weather window game: look outside and tell me — is it sunny, cloudy or rainy today?
scene.intro: Weather window game! Every morning Freya looks outside and says the weather. Today it is windy: the trees are dancing and her hat flies away. Yesterday it was rainy and she needed her red umbrella. When it is sunny they go out, when it is cold they stay in with hot chocolate. Look — after the rain, a rainbow! Is it sunny or rainy where YOU are? Look out and tell us!

data.voice_note: Voces: Freya (reportera del clima) y Nico (ayudante).
data.script: Freya: Weather report! On Monday it was sunny. We played outside. … Nico: On Tuesday it was rainy. Umbrella day! … Freya: On Wednesday it was windy — my hat flew away! … Nico: Pip caught it in the air! … Freya: On Thursday it was cloudy. We saw a cloud like an elephant. … Nico: And today? Look out of the window… … Freya: SUNNY! Park afternoon, here we come!
